title: Special permit for towers at 110 East 138th Street, Bronx
summary: The city's housing agency HPD seeks a special permit to adjust height, setback, tower and rear yard rules for two new mixed-use buildings at 63 Exterior Street and 110 East 138th Street in the Bronx. The site sits in an R7-2/C2-4 district within the Special Harlem River Waterfront District's Core Subdistrict, in Community District 1 and Council District 8.
